events.name: SideQuest IRL #44
events.description:
Join us for an afternoon of pursuing your personal side quest! Whether you’re writing, coding, or doing those taxes you’ve been putting off, this is your space. It’s intentional time for you to focus on what feels meaningful to you—and meet people doing the same thing. We’ll split our time between focused work sessions and breaks to reset and mingle with other creators.
Rough Agenda*
2:30-3:00pm: Introductions and Intention Sharing
3:00-4:30pm: Deep focus session 1
4:30-4:50pm: Optional break
4:50-5:30pm: Deep focus session 2
5:30-6:00pm: SideQuest Shares
*Popular opinion is that SideQuest is best when you’re all in, showing up for the duration instead of splitting sessions. Try it—we think you’ll agree.
___________________

About SideQuest:
We host coworking sessions every other Sunday. Subscribe to our events calendar if you can’t make this one :)
If you've got ideas for how to help build the community, or you'd like to host a future SideQuest (it's easier than you might think!), we'd love to hear from you.
Thank you to Fractal Campus for hosting us, our friends at PurdueHackers, CozySundays and Socratica for seeding the idea, and Chandiran for building the SideQuest community.
